up: Find all molecules reported in document CHEMBL4004822. Return their ChEMBL IDs, names (pref_name), max phase, molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES. Join the documents table with compound_records to filter by the specific document, then join with molecule_dictionary for molecule attributes and compound_structures for SMILES. Do not apply any additional filters on document type, assay confidence, or target type. Return all matching rows without a row limit.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4004822'
